title: PHP critical RCE security releases (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619)
unpatched_lines_note: PHP 8.1 and older get no release from the PHP project. Some distributions and LTS vendors ship backported fixes; the PHP security team also published minimal source backports for 7.4, 8.0 and 8.1. Otherwise upgrade to a supported line. PHP 8.2 reaches end of life on 31 December 2026.

cves.summary: RCE via out-of-memory corruption: an OOM longjmp leaves partially initialized request memory that request shutdown then consumes
RCE via stale global state: request-owned state survives into the next request on the same worker (use after free)

affected_deployments: Apache mod_php (highest risk, exploit runs before application code)
mitigations_not_fixes: CVE-2026-109618: enforce memory_limit=-1 administratively (php_admin_value in the FPM pool or Apache config), keep post_max_size low (8M without uploads, 32M with), keep upload_max_filesize below post_max_size, and bound decoded body size, input fields, multipart parts, headers and nesting at the proxy, including requests without a usable Content-Length.
CVE-2026-109618: never use RLIMIT_AS or RLIMIT_DATA as a mitigation; they trigger the vulnerable allocation-failure path.

CVE-2026-109619: set session.upload_progress.enabled=0 in php.ini, the FPM pool or server config (not ini_set() or .user.ini) and restart every worker. On 8.5 also set fatal_error_backtraces=0. Remove invalid or deprecated per-request INI settings that emit diagnostics before request initialization; hiding diagnostics with error_reporting, display_errors or @ does not help.
notes: Distro packages backport fixes without changing the upstream version string, so php -v is not evidence. Check the vendor's security tracker or package changelog.
The PHP project warned that rpms.remirepo.net would not have same-day updates; prefer distribution packages or source builds.
Changing Composer require.php or config.platform.php does not change the runtime and patches nothing.
Source builds must use the new php.net tarball and verify its published checksum.
